id-20260925-news-3.title: US Bond Yield Highest Since 2007 and Brent Above US$100, JCI Drops 1.2 Percent and Rupiah Opens at Rp17,902

segments.src: Pasar keuangan global kembali bergejolak.
segments.tr: Global financial markets are volatile again.

segments.src: Imbal hasil (yield) obligasi pemerintah Amerika Serikat (US Treasury) tenor 10 tahun naik ke 5,11 persen, level tertinggi sejak 2007.
segments.tr: The yield on the 10-year US government bond (US Treasury) rose to 5.11 percent, the highest level since 2007.

segments.src: Pada saat yang sama, harga minyak mentah Brent kembali berada di atas US$100 per barel.
segments.tr: At the same time, Brent crude oil prices were back above US$100 per barrel.

segments.src: Di dalam negeri, Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) ditutup turun 1,2 persen ke level 6.298, sedangkan rupiah dibuka di Rp17.902 per dolar AS.
segments.tr: Domestically, the Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) closed down 1.2 percent at the 6,298 level, while the rupiah opened at Rp17,902 per US dollar.

segments.src: ## Pemicu: Keraguan Iran atas Perundingan Damai
segments.tr: ## Trigger: Iran's Doubts Over Peace Talks

segments.src: Pemicu utama tekanan di pasar adalah sikap Iran yang meragukan kemajuan perundingan damai dengan Amerika Serikat.
segments.tr: The main trigger for market pressure is Iran's stance doubting the progress of peace talks with the United States.

segments.src: Ketika harapan atas meredanya ketegangan melemah, pelaku pasar cenderung kembali memperhitungkan risiko gangguan pasokan energi.
segments.tr: When hopes for easing tensions weaken, market players tend to reprice the risk of energy supply disruptions.

segments.src: Kawasan Timur Tengah merupakan salah satu pusat produksi dan jalur distribusi minyak dunia, sehingga kabar geopolitik di wilayah tersebut kerap langsung tercermin pada harga minyak.
segments.tr: The Middle East region is one of the world's production centers and distribution routes for oil, so geopolitical news in the region is often directly reflected in oil prices.

segments.src: Akibatnya, Brent kembali menembus level US$100 per barel.
segments.tr: As a result, Brent broke back through the US$100 per barrel level.

segments.src: Harga minyak yang tinggi memengaruhi biaya produksi, ongkos transportasi, hingga ekspektasi inflasi di banyak negara.
segments.tr: High oil prices affect production costs, transportation expenses, and inflation expectations in many countries.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Yield US Treasury Ikut Naik?
segments.tr: ## Why Did US Treasury Yields Rise Too?

segments.src: Yield obligasi bergerak berlawanan dengan harga obligasi.
segments.tr: Bond yields move inversely to bond prices.

segments.src: Ketika investor menuntut imbal hasil lebih tinggi, harga obligasi turun dan yield naik.
segments.tr: When investors demand higher returns, bond prices fall and yields rise.

segments.src: Ada beberapa faktor yang umumnya berperan:
segments.tr: There are several factors that generally play a role:

segments.src: - **Ekspektasi inflasi.** Harga energi yang tinggi dapat mendorong inflasi. Jika inflasi diperkirakan bertahan tinggi, investor meminta kompensasi lebih besar untuk memegang obligasi jangka panjang.
segments.tr: - **Inflation expectations.** High energy prices can drive inflation. If inflation is expected to remain high, investors demand greater compensation for holding long-term bonds.

segments.src: - **Suku bunga yang dinilai tetap tinggi.** Inflasi yang sulit turun dapat membuat pasar menilai bank sentral AS belum leluasa melonggarkan kebijakan moneter.
segments.tr: - **Interest rates assessed to remain high.** Inflation that is difficult to drop can make the market assess that the US central bank is not yet free to ease monetary policy.

segments.src: - **Kebutuhan pembiayaan pemerintah.** Pasokan obligasi yang besar juga dapat menambah tekanan pada yield.
segments.tr: - **Government financing needs.** A large supply of bonds can also add pressure to yields.

segments.src: Yield 10 tahun di 5,11 persen adalah patokan penting, karena menjadi acuan bagi banyak instrumen keuangan, mulai dari suku bunga kredit hingga valuasi aset berisiko di seluruh dunia.
segments.tr: The 10-year yield at 5.11 percent is an important benchmark, as it serves as a reference for many financial instruments, ranging from credit interest rates to the valuation of risky assets worldwide.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke IHSG: Saham Perbankan Tertekan
segments.tr: ## Impact on JCI: Banking Stocks Under Pressure

segments.src: IHSG ditutup melemah 1,2 persen ke level 6.298.
segments.tr: The JCI closed down 1.2 percent at the 6,298 level.

segments.src: Sektor perbankan menjadi salah satu yang tertekan.
segments.tr: The banking sector was one of those under pressure.

segments.src: Secara umum, ada beberapa jalur yang bisa menjelaskan hal ini:
segments.tr: In general, there are several channels that can explain this:

segments.src: 1. **Aliran dana asing.** Saham perbankan berkapitalisasi besar biasanya banyak dimiliki investor asing. Ketika yield di AS naik, aset berdenominasi dolar menjadi lebih menarik, sehingga sebagian dana berpotensi keluar dari pasar negara berkembang.
segments.tr: 1. **Foreign capital flows.** Large-cap banking stocks are usually heavily owned by foreign investors. When US yields rise, dollar-denominated assets become more attractive, so some funds have the potential to flow out of emerging markets.

segments.src: 2. **Biaya dana dan portofolio surat berharga.** Kenaikan yield global dapat menekan harga obligasi yang dipegang perbankan dan mendorong biaya dana naik.
segments.tr: 2. **Cost of funds and securities portfolio.** Rising global yields can pressure bond prices held by banks and drive up funding costs.

segments.src: 3. **Sentimen risiko.** Kombinasi harga minyak tinggi dan ketidakpastian geopolitik membuat investor cenderung lebih berhati-hati.
segments.tr: 3. **Risk sentiment.** The combination of high oil prices and geopolitical uncertainty makes investors tend to be more cautious.

segments.src: ## Rupiah di Level Rp17.902 per Dolar AS
segments.tr: ## Rupiah at Rp17,902 per US Dollar

segments.src: Rupiah dibuka di Rp17.902 per dolar AS.
segments.tr: The rupiah opened at Rp17,902 per US dollar.

segments.src: Naiknya yield US Treasury cenderung menguatkan dolar AS karena aset dolar menawarkan imbal hasil lebih tinggi.
segments.tr: Rising US Treasury yields tend to strengthen the US dollar because dollar assets offer higher returns.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, tekanan dari harga minyak juga patut dicermati.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, pressure from oil prices also deserves close attention.

segments.src: Indonesia merupakan negara pengimpor minyak neto, sehingga harga minyak yang tinggi berpotensi menambah kebutuhan valuta asing untuk impor energi dan memengaruhi neraca perdagangan serta beban subsidi energi.
segments.tr: Indonesia is a net oil-importing country, so high oil prices have the potential to increase foreign exchange needs for energy imports and affect the trade balance as well as the energy subsidy burden.

segments.src: Meski begitu, arah kurs ke depan tetap bergantung pada banyak faktor, termasuk kebijakan Bank Indonesia, kondisi neraca perdagangan, arus modal, dan perkembangan geopolitik.
segments.tr: Even so, the future exchange rate direction still depends on many factors, including Bank Indonesia's policy, trade balance conditions, capital flows, and geopolitical developments.

segments.src: ## Hal yang Perlu Dicermati Pelaku Pasar
segments.tr: ## Things for Market Players to Watch

segments.src: - **Perkembangan perundingan Iran–AS.** Kabar positif atau negatif dari meja perundingan dapat langsung menggerakkan harga minyak.
segments.tr: - **Iran–US negotiations developments.** Positive or negative news from the negotiating table can directly move oil prices.

segments.src: - **Data inflasi dan sinyal kebijakan bank sentral AS.** Keduanya menjadi penentu arah yield dan dolar AS.
segments.tr: - **Inflation data and US central bank policy signals.** Both are determinants of the direction of yields and the US dollar.

segments.src: - **Pergerakan yield SBN Indonesia.** Kenaikan yield global biasanya merambat ke imbal hasil surat berharga negara.
segments.tr: - **Movement of Indonesian government bond (SBN) yields.** Global yield increases usually spread to government securities yields.

segments.src: - **Respons kebijakan domestik.** Langkah Bank Indonesia dan pemerintah dalam menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar dan pasar keuangan.
segments.tr: - **Domestic policy response.** Steps by Bank Indonesia and the government in maintaining exchange rate stability and financial markets.

segments.tr: ## Important Notes

id-20260925-news-1.title: Free Tuition at State Universities Prepared Gradually, Pratikno's Special Team Calculates UKT and Independent Admission IPI

segments.src: Pemerintah mulai menyiapkan langkah konkret untuk mewujudkan kuliah gratis di perguruan tinggi negeri (PTN).
segments.tr: The government has begun preparing concrete steps to realize free tuition at state universities (PTN).

segments.src: Setelah rapat terbatas di Istana Merdeka, Jakarta, pada Rabu, 23 September 2026, Presiden Prabowo Subianto menginstruksikan agar program ini disiapkan secepat mungkin, tetapi dijalankan secara bertahap.
segments.tr: Following a limited meeting at the Merdeka Palace, Jakarta, on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, President Prabowo Subianto instructed that this program be prepared as quickly as possible, but implemented gradually.

segments.src: Untuk itu, dibentuk tim khusus lintas kementerian yang dipimpin Menteri Koordinator Bidang Pembangunan Manusia dan Kebudayaan (Menko PMK) Pratikno.
segments.tr: To that end, a special cross-ministerial team has been formed, led by the Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture (Menko PMK) Pratikno.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Diputuskan dalam Rapat Terbatas
segments.tr: ## What Was Decided in the Limited Meeting

segments.src: Informasi mengenai hasil rapat disampaikan oleh Menteri Pendidikan Tinggi, Sains, dan Teknologi, Brian Yuliarto.
segments.tr: Information regarding the results of the meeting was conveyed by the Minister of Higher Education, Science, and Technology, Brian Yuliarto.

segments.src: Pokok-pokoknya:
segments.tr: The main points are:

segments.src: - **Arah kebijakan:** kuliah gratis di PTN disiapkan secepatnya, dengan pelaksanaan bertahap.
segments.tr: - **Policy direction:** free tuition at PTN is to be prepared as soon as possible, with gradual implementation.

segments.src: - **Pembentukan tim khusus:** dipimpin Menko PMK Pratikno, dengan anggota dari Kementerian Sekretariat Negara, Kementerian Agama, Kementerian Keuangan, dan Kementerian Pendidikan Tinggi, Sains, dan Teknologi.
segments.tr: - **Formation of a special team:** led by Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture Pratikno, with members from the Ministry of State Secretariat, Ministry of Religious Affairs, Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, and Technology.

segments.src: - **Tugas utama tim:** menghitung komponen pembiayaan PTN yang selama ini menjadi sumber pendapatan kampus.
segments.tr: - **Main task of the team:** to calculate the components of PTN funding that have been a source of campus revenue.

segments.src: - **Target waktu:** hasil perhitungan diharapkan keluar dalam kisaran dua minggu hingga satu bulan.
segments.tr: - **Time target:** the calculation results are expected to be released within a range of two weeks to one month.

segments.src: - **Batasan fiskal:** kebijakan dirancang dengan mempertimbangkan ruang fiskal yang tersedia dalam APBN.
segments.tr: - **Fiscal constraints:** the policy is designed by considering the fiscal space available in the state budget (APBN).

segments.src: ## Apa yang Akan Dihitung Tim Khusus
segments.tr: ## What the Special Team Will Calculate

segments.src: Tim akan memetakan berapa besar pendapatan PTN dari sejumlah sumber, antara lain:
segments.tr: The team will map out how much revenue PTNs receive from a number of sources, including:

segments.src: 1. **Uang Kuliah Tunggal (UKT)**, yaitu biaya kuliah yang dibayar mahasiswa setiap semester dan besarnya disesuaikan dengan kemampuan ekonomi keluarga.
segments.tr: 1. **Single Tuition Fee (UKT)**, which is the tuition fee paid by students every semester, with the amount adjusted to the family's economic capacity.

segments.src: 2. **Iuran Pengembangan Institusi (IPI) jalur mandiri**, yaitu pungutan yang di sejumlah PTN dikenakan kepada mahasiswa baru yang masuk lewat seleksi mandiri.
segments.tr: 2. **Institutional Development Contribution (IPI) for independent admission**, which is a levy charged at a number of PTNs to new students who enter through independent selection.

segments.src: 3. **Pendapatan lain PTN**, termasuk skema subsidi silang, misalnya dari program pascasarjana ke program sarjana.
segments.tr: 3. **Other PTN revenue**, including cross-subsidy schemes, for example from postgraduate programs to undergraduate programs.

segments.src: Angka-angka inilah yang akan menjadi dasar untuk menjawab pertanyaan paling mendasar: berapa kebutuhan dana negara jika biaya kuliah mahasiswa PTN ditanggung pemerintah, dan seberapa besar bagian yang bisa dibiayai pada tahap awal.
segments.tr: These figures will be the basis for answering the most fundamental question: how much state funding is needed if PTN student tuition fees are covered by the government, and how much can be financed in the initial stage.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Dilakukan Bertahap
segments.tr: ## Why It Is Being Done Gradually

segments.src: Pendekatan bertahap dipilih karena pembiayaan pendidikan tinggi melibatkan banyak variabel.
segments.tr: A gradual approach was chosen because higher education financing involves many variables.

segments.src: Setiap PTN memiliki struktur pendapatan dan kebutuhan operasional yang berbeda.
segments.tr: Every PTN has a different revenue structure and operational needs.

segments.src: Jika UKT dan IPI ditiadakan atau dikurangi, selisih pendapatannya harus ditutup dari sumber lain agar mutu layanan akademik, fasilitas, dan penelitian tidak terganggu.
segments.tr: If UKT and IPI are eliminated or reduced, the difference in revenue must be covered from other sources so that the quality of academic services, facilities, and research is not disrupted.

segments.src: Menurut pemberitaan, sejumlah opsi implementasi masih dikaji, misalnya membebaskan biaya kuliah bagi seluruh mahasiswa, memprioritaskan mahasiswa baru terlebih dahulu, atau menentukan penerima berdasarkan kelompok kemampuan ekonomi tertentu.
segments.tr: According to reports, a number of implementation options are still being studied, for example, waiving tuition fees for all students, prioritizing new students first, or determining recipients based on certain economic capacity groups.

segments.src: Pemerintah belum menetapkan opsi mana yang akan dipilih.
segments.tr: The government has not yet determined which option will be chosen.

segments.src: Pilihan itu diperkirakan baru mengerucut setelah tim khusus menyerahkan hasil hitungannya.
segments.tr: That choice is expected to narrow down only after the special team submits its calculation results.

segments.src: ## Apa Artinya bagi Calon Mahasiswa dan Orang Tua
segments.tr: ## What This Means for Prospective Students and Parents

segments.src: Untuk saat ini, program kuliah gratis di PTN **masih berada pada tahap kajian dan perhitungan**, belum berupa kebijakan yang berlaku.
segments.tr: For now, the free tuition program at PTN **is still at the study and calculation stage**, not yet a policy in effect.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang perlu dipahami:
segments.tr: Some things that need to be understood:

segments.src: - **Ketentuan UKT dan IPI yang berlaku saat ini belum berubah.** Calon mahasiswa tetap perlu mengikuti aturan dan pengumuman resmi dari kampus tujuan.
segments.tr: - **The currently applicable UKT and IPI provisions have not changed.** Prospective students still need to follow the rules and official announcements from their target campus.

segments.src: - **Belum ada rincian** mengenai kapan program mulai berjalan, kelompok mahasiswa mana yang lebih dulu mendapat manfaat, maupun besaran anggarannya.
segments.tr: - **There are no details yet** regarding when the program will start, which group of students will benefit first, or the amount of the budget.

segments.src: - **Informasi resmi** sebaiknya dirujuk dari Kementerian Pendidikan Tinggi, Sains, dan Teknologi, Sekretariat Negara, serta laman resmi masing-masing PTN, bukan dari kabar yang beredar di media sosial atau pesan berantai.
segments.tr: - **Official information** should be referenced from the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, and Technology, the State Secretariat, and the official websites of each PTN, not from news circulating on social media or chain messages.

segments.src: ## Hal yang Perlu Dicermati ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Things to Watch Going Forward

segments.src: Ada beberapa pertanyaan yang akan menentukan wajah kebijakan ini setelah hasil hitungan keluar:
segments.tr: There are several questions that will determine the face of this policy after the calculation results are out:

segments.src: - **Cakupan penerima:** apakah semua mahasiswa PTN atau dimulai dari kelompok tertentu.
segments.tr: - **Recipient coverage:** whether it is all PTN students or starting from certain groups.

segments.src: - **Sumber pendanaan:** seberapa besar beban yang ditanggung APBN dan bagaimana kesinambungannya dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: - **Funding sources:** how much of the burden is borne by the APBN and how sustainable it is in the long term.

segments.src: - **Nasib jalur mandiri:** bagaimana pungutan IPI diperlakukan, mengingat jalur ini selama ini menjadi salah satu sumber pendapatan PTN sekaligus sering menuai sorotan soal keterjangkauan.
segments.tr: - **The fate of independent admission:** how the IPI levy is treated, considering that this path has been one of the sources of PTN revenue while often drawing attention regarding affordability.

segments.src: - **Mutu pendidikan:** bagaimana memastikan kualitas pengajaran dan fasilitas tetap terjaga ketika komposisi pendapatan kampus berubah.
segments.tr: - **Quality of education:** how to ensure the quality of teaching and facilities is maintained when the campus revenue composition changes.

segments.src: - **Kesiapan kampus:** bagaimana PTN dengan model pengelolaan berbeda menyesuaikan diri dengan skema baru.
segments.tr: - **Campus readiness:** how PTNs with different management models adapt to the new scheme.

segments.src: Jika target waktu terpenuhi, gambaran yang lebih jelas mengenai skema, tahapan, dan kebutuhan anggaran bisa diketahui paling cepat dalam dua minggu ke depan, atau paling lambat sekitar satu bulan sejak rapat terbatas digelar.
segments.tr: If the time target is met, a clearer picture of the scheme, stages, and budget requirements could be known as early as the next two weeks, or at the latest about one month since the limited meeting was held.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan disusun berdasarkan informasi resmi serta pemberitaan yang tersedia per 25 September 2026.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is informative and was compiled based on official information and news available as of September 25, 2026.

segments.src: Kebijakan masih dapat berubah seiring hasil kajian dan keputusan pemerintah selanjutnya.*
segments.tr: The policy may still change in line with the results of further studies and government decisions.*

id-20260925-news-2.title: Presidential Regulation 82/2026 Issued: Merah Putih Village Cooperatives Have Governance Rules, Agrinas to Manage Outlets for First Two Years

segments.src: Pemerintah resmi memiliki payung hukum baru untuk Koperasi Desa/Kelurahan Merah Putih (KDKMP).
segments.tr: The government officially has a new legal framework for the Merah Putih Village/Sub-district Cooperatives (KDKMP).

segments.src: Presiden Prabowo Subianto menandatangani Peraturan Presiden (Perpres) Nomor 82 Tahun 2026 tentang tata kelola penyelenggaraan koperasi tersebut.
segments.tr: President Prabowo Subianto signed Presidential Regulation (Perpres) Number 82 of 2026 concerning the governance of these cooperatives.

segments.src: Kabar penerbitannya disampaikan Kepala Staf Kepresidenan (KSP) Dudung Abdurachman pada 23 September 2026, dan dilaporkan sejumlah media nasional.
segments.tr: News of its issuance was conveyed by the Chief of Presidential Staff (KSP) Dudung Abdurachman on September 23, 2026, and reported by a number of national media outlets.

segments.src: Aturan ini dimaksudkan menjadi landasan agar penyiapan dan pengoperasian Kopdes Merah Putih berjalan lebih tertib, terkoordinasi, dan cepat.
segments.tr: This regulation is intended to serve as a foundation so that the preparation and operation of the Merah Putih Village Cooperatives run more orderly, coordinated, and quickly.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Diatur dalam Perpres 82/2026?
segments.tr: ## What is Regulated in Presidential Regulation 82/2026?

segments.src: Secara garis besar, perpres ini mengatur bagaimana koperasi desa dan kelurahan dikelola dan dioperasikan.
segments.tr: Broadly speaking, this presidential regulation governs how village and sub-district cooperatives are managed and operated.

segments.src: Salah satu poin utamanya adalah penugasan kepada **PT Agrinas Pangan Nusantara**, perusahaan yang berada di lingkungan BUMN, untuk mengoperasikan gerai Kopdes Merah Putih selama **dua tahun pertama**.
segments.tr: One of its main points is the assignment to **PT Agrinas Pangan Nusantara**, a company within the state-owned enterprise (BUMN) environment, to operate Merah Putih Village Cooperative outlets for the **first two years**.

segments.src: Skema ini memberi kejelasan pihak yang bertanggung jawab atas operasional harian gerai pada fase awal.
segments.tr: This scheme provides clarity on which party is responsible for the daily operations of the outlets in the initial phase.

segments.src: Dengan begitu, koperasi yang baru berdiri tidak harus membangun seluruh sistem usaha dari nol.
segments.tr: That way, newly established cooperatives do not have to build their entire business system from scratch.

segments.src: ## Manajer Kopdes Segera Ditempatkan
segments.tr: ## Cooperative Managers to be Placed Soon

segments.src: Dari sisi sumber daya manusia, surat keputusan (SK) penetapan manajer Kopdes dilaporkan sudah terbit.
segments.tr: In terms of human resources, the decree (SK) for the appointment of cooperative managers has reportedly been issued.

segments.src: Para manajer akan berstatus pegawai di bawah Agrinas dengan perjanjian kerja waktu tertentu (PKWT) selama dua tahun.
segments.tr: The managers will have the status of employees under Agrinas with a fixed-term employment agreement (PKWT) for two years.

segments.src: Setelah itu, kinerja mereka dievaluasi untuk menentukan apakah kontrak dapat dilanjutkan.
segments.tr: After that, their performance will be evaluated to determine whether the contract can be continued.

segments.src: Menurut pemberitaan, jumlah manajer yang disiapkan mencapai puluhan ribu orang (disebut sekitar 28.626 orang) dan akan ditempatkan di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: According to reports, the number of managers prepared reaches tens of thousands (stated as approximately 28,626 people) and they will be placed in various regions.

segments.src: Mereka diharapkan segera mulai bekerja agar gerai bisa beroperasi sesuai jadwal.
segments.tr: They are expected to start working immediately so that the outlets can operate according to schedule.

segments.src: ## Pasokan Barang Pokok dan Barang Bersubsidi
segments.tr: ## Supply of Basic Goods and Subsidized Goods

segments.src: Pemerintah menyatakan akan menjamin ketersediaan sejumlah komoditas yang dijual di gerai Kopdes Merah Putih, yaitu:
segments.tr: The government stated it will guarantee the availability of a number of commodities sold at Merah Putih Village Cooperative outlets, namely:

segments.src: - **Beras**, termasuk beras program stabilisasi pasokan dan harga (SPHP);
segments.tr: - **Rice**, including rice from the supply and price stabilization program (SPHP);

segments.src: - **LPG 3 kg**;
segments.tr: - **3 kg LPG**;

segments.src: - **Pupuk bersubsidi**;
segments.tr: - **Subsidized fertilizer**;

segments.src: - **Minyakita**, minyak goreng bermerek program pemerintah;
segments.tr: - **Minyakita**, the government program branded cooking oil;

segments.src: - kebutuhan pokok lainnya.
segments.tr: - other basic necessities.

segments.src: Untuk menjaga kesinambungan pasokan, KSP, Kementerian Koperasi, dan Agrinas berkoordinasi dengan mitra distribusi seperti Perum Bulog dan Pertamina Patra Niaga.
segments.tr: To maintain supply continuity, the KSP, the Ministry of Cooperatives, and Agrinas are coordinating with distribution partners such as Perum Bulog and Pertamina Patra Niaga.

segments.src: Menurut Dudung Abdurachman, masyarakat perlu bisa memperoleh barang-barang tersebut dengan mudah dan pada harga yang sesuai ketentuan, terutama untuk komoditas bersubsidi.
segments.tr: According to Dudung Abdurachman, the public needs to be able to obtain these goods easily and at prices in accordance with regulations, especially for subsidized commodities.

segments.src: ## Soft Launching Dijadwalkan Oktober
segments.tr: ## Soft Launching Scheduled for October

segments.src: Pemerintah menjadwalkan *soft launching* operasional gerai pada **Oktober 2026**.
segments.tr: The government has scheduled the *soft launching* of outlet operations for **October 2026**.

segments.src: Sebelum itu, sejumlah pekerjaan teknis masih perlu dituntaskan, antara lain:
segments.tr: Before that, a number of technical tasks still need to be completed, including:

segments.tr: 1. establishing the status of the village cooperative as a commodity distribution point;

segments.src: 2. penetapan alokasi dan kesinambungan pasokan;

segments.src: 3. penyediaan modal kerja;
segments.tr: 3. providing working capital;

segments.src: 4. penataan logistik dan pergudangan;
segments.tr: 4. organizing logistics and warehousing;

segments.src: 5. penyiapan sistem transaksi dan pengawasan.
segments.tr: 5. preparing transaction and supervision systems.

segments.src: Perpres ini juga dijadwalkan segera disosialisasikan kepada pihak-pihak yang terlibat di daerah.
segments.tr: This presidential regulation is also scheduled to be socialized soon to the parties involved in the regions.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Ini Penting bagi Warga Desa dan Kelurahan?
segments.tr: ## Why is This Important for Village and Sub-district Residents?

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, kehadiran gerai koperasi yang menjual kebutuhan pokok berpotensi mempermudah akses terhadap barang yang selama ini dibeli melalui rantai distribusi yang panjang.
segments.tr: For the community, the presence of cooperative outlets selling basic necessities has the potential to facilitate access to goods that have previously been purchased through long distribution chains.

segments.src: Bagi pemerintah, aturan tata kelola diharapkan membuat pembagian peran antara koperasi, BUMN, dan kementerian menjadi lebih jelas.
segments.tr: For the government, the governance rules are expected to make the division of roles between cooperatives, state-owned enterprises, and ministries clearer.

segments.tr: ## Things to Watch

id-20260925-intro-retail-7.title: [Retail #7] Stores That Try to Serve Everyone Are Usually Not Chosen by Anyone

segments.src: > Strategi ritel adalah tiga keputusan yang saling mengunci: siapa yang kita layani, dengan bauran ritel seperti apa, dan kenapa mereka harus memilih kita — bukan toko sebelah.
segments.tr: > Retail strategy is three mutually reinforcing decisions: whom we serve, with what retail mix, and why they should choose us—not the store next door.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Banyak pemilik toko mengira "strategi" itu urusan iklan.
segments.tr: Many store owners think "strategy" is about advertising.

segments.src: Padahal dalam ilmu ritel, strategi ritel punya arti yang jauh lebih sempit dan lebih tajam: sebuah pernyataan yang menjawab tiga pertanyaan sekaligus.
segments.tr: Yet in retail science, retail strategy has a much narrower and sharper meaning: a statement that answers three questions at once.

segments.src: Pasar sasaran (target market): siapa yang kita layani?**
segments.tr: Target market: whom do we serve?**

segments.src: Bukan "semua orang yang punya uang", tapi kelompok pembeli yang cukup jelas untuk bisa dibayangkan wajahnya.
segments.tr: Not "anyone with money," but a group of buyers clear enough to picture in your mind.

segments.src: Prosesnya biasa disingkat STP: *segmentation* (membelah pasar jadi kelompok-kelompok), *targeting* (memilih kelompok mana yang dikejar), *positioning* (menentukan mau dikenal sebagai apa).
segments.tr: The process is usually abbreviated STP: *segmentation* (dividing the market into groups), *targeting* (choosing which groups to pursue), *positioning* (determining how you want to be known).

segments.src: Segmen yang layak dikejar umumnya punya empat sifat: cukup besar untuk menghidupi toko, bisa dijangkau, kebutuhannya berbeda dari segmen lain, dan mampu kita layani lebih baik daripada pesaing.
segments.tr: A worthwhile segment typically has four traits: large enough to sustain the store, reachable, distinct needs from other segments, and one we can serve better than competitors.

segments.src: Bauran ritel (retail mix): dengan cara apa kita melayani mereka?**
segments.tr: Retail mix: how do we serve them?**

segments.src: Ini kotak peralatan sehari-hari peritel, dan biasanya terdiri dari enam elemen:
segments.tr: This is the everyday toolkit of retailers, and usually consists of six elements:

segments.src: - **Ragam barang (assortment)** — mau lengkap tapi dangkal, atau sempit tapi dalam?
segments.tr: - **Product assortment** — do you want broad but shallow, or narrow but deep?

segments.src: - **Harga** — margin tipis putaran cepat, atau margin tebal putaran lambat?
segments.tr: - **Price** — thin margins with fast turnover, or fat margins with slow turnover?

segments.src: - **Lokasi dan saluran** — mulut gang, pusat perbelanjaan, atau lapak di marketplace?
segments.tr: - **Location and channel** — street-front alley entrance, shopping mall, or marketplace stall?

segments.src: - **Komunikasi/promosi** — spanduk, grup WhatsApp RT, atau konten media sosial?
segments.tr: - **Communication/promotion** — banners, neighborhood WhatsApp group, or social media content?

segments.src: - **Suasana dan tata letak toko** — terang dan cepat, atau nyaman untuk berlama-lama?
segments.tr: - **Store atmosphere and layout** — bright and quick, or comfortable for lingering?

segments.src: - **Layanan dan SDM** — layani sendiri, atau ada yang mengantar dan mengingat nama pelanggan?
segments.tr: - **Service and staff** — self-service, or someone who delivers and remembers customer names?

segments.src: Keunggulan bersaing yang berkelanjutan: kenapa keunggulan itu tidak gampang ditiru?**
segments.tr: Sustainable competitive advantage: why isn't this advantage easy to copy?**

segments.src: Potongan harga bisa ditiru pesaing besok pagi.
segments.tr: Price cuts can be copied by competitors tomorrow morning.

segments.src: Yang sulit ditiru biasanya hal-hal yang menumpuk pelan-pelan: hubungan dengan pelanggan setia, lokasi yang memang cuma satu-satunya di mulut gang, hubungan baik dengan pemasok, sistem stok yang rapi, dan orang-orang yang sudah terlatih.
segments.tr: What's hard to copy are things that accumulate slowly: relationships with loyal customers, a location that's truly unique at the alley entrance, good relationships with suppliers, a neat inventory system, and trained staff.

segments.src: Kunci yang paling sering dilupakan: **ketiga hal itu harus konsisten satu sama lain.** Toko yang menjanjikan "termurah" tapi memasang AC, sofa, dan barista terlatih akan kesulitan menutup biaya.
segments.tr: The key most often overlooked: **these three things must be consistent with each other.** A store that promises "cheapest" but installs air conditioning, offers sofas, and trains a barista will struggle to cover costs.

segments.src: Toko yang menjanjikan "premium" tapi rak berdebu dan kasirnya cemberut akan kehilangan alasan untuk dibayar mahal.
segments.tr: A store that promises "premium" but has dusty shelves and a grumpy cashier loses the reason to command high prices.

segments.src: Positioning bukan slogan di spanduk; positioning adalah **janji yang dibuktikan oleh setiap elemen bauran ritel**.
segments.tr: Positioning isn't a slogan on a banner; positioning is **a promise proven by every element of the retail mix**.

segments.src: Dan karena sumber daya terbatas, strategi selalu berarti **memilih untuk tidak melakukan sesuatu**.
segments.tr: And because resources are limited, strategy always means **choosing not to do something**.

segments.src: Anda tidak bisa sekaligus jadi yang termurah, terlengkap, tercepat, dan termewah.
segments.tr: You can't be the cheapest, most complete, fastest, and most luxurious all at once.

segments.src: Salah satunya harus dikorbankan — itu yang disebut *trade-off*.
segments.tr: One of them must be sacrificed—that's called a *trade-off*.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Practice

segments.src: Bayangkan Bu Ratna punya toko kelontong di sebuah perumahan padat di Bekasi.
segments.tr: Imagine Bu Ratna owns a grocery store in a crowded residential area in Bekasi.

segments.src: Enam bulan lalu sebuah minimarket berjaringan buka 200 meter dari tokonya, dan omzetnya turun.
segments.tr: Six months ago, a chain convenience store opened 200 meters from her shop, and her revenue dropped.

segments.src: Reaksi pertamanya wajar: ikut menurunkan harga semua barang.
segments.tr: Her first reaction was natural: she followed suit and lowered prices on everything.

segments.src: Hasilnya?
segments.tr: The result?

segments.src: Marginnya habis, sementara minimarket itu tetap lebih murah karena membeli dalam jumlah jauh lebih besar.
segments.tr: Her margins evaporated, while the minimarket stayed cheaper because it buys in much larger quantities.

segments.src: Ini contoh klasik toko yang bersaing di medan pertempuran milik pesaing.
segments.tr: This is a classic example of a store fighting on its competitor's battlefield.

segments.src: Coba susun ulang dengan tiga pertanyaan tadi.
segments.tr: Let's reorganize using those three questions.

segments.src: **Pasar sasaran.** Bukan seluruh warga perumahan, tapi ibu rumah tangga dan anak kos dalam radius 300 meter yang butuh belanja **dadakan dan eceran** — telur lima butir jam sembilan malam, gas melon 3 kg yang habis saat sedang menggoreng, beras satu liter menjelang tanggal tua.
segments.tr: **Target market:** Not all residents of the complex, but housewives and boarding students within 300 meters who need **emergency and small-quantity shopping**—five eggs at nine p.m., 3 kg LPG that ran out while cooking, one liter of rice near month-end.

segments.src: **Positioning.** "Belanja darurat, eceran, dan diantar dalam 10 menit."
segments.tr: **Positioning:** "Emergency shopping, small quantities, delivered in 10 minutes."

segments.src: Perhatikan: sama sekali tidak menyebut kata "murah".
segments.tr: Notice: no mention of "cheap" at all.

segments.src: **Bauran ritel yang mendukung janji itu:**
segments.tr: **Retail mix supporting that promise:**

segments.src: - *Ragam barang*: sekitar 300 jenis barang yang paling cepat berputar saja — bukan 3.000. Rak untuk barang yang laku sebulan sekali diganti stok telur, gas, dan mi instan.
segments.tr: - *Product assortment:* about 300 of the fastest-moving items only—not 3,000. Shelves that sell monthly are replaced by stock of eggs, gas, and instant noodles.

segments.src: - *Harga*: harga bersaing untuk barang yang harganya dihafal orang (mi instan, gula, minyak goreng), tapi tidak berusaha mengalahkan minimarket di semua lini. Kompensasinya ada di kemudahan eceran.
segments.tr: - *Price:* competitive on items people know the price of (instant noodles, sugar, cooking oil), but not trying to beat the minimarket across the board. The trade-off is offset by ease of small-quantity buying.

segments.src: - *Lokasi*: sudah menang — persis di mulut gang yang dilewati semua orang pulang kerja.
segments.tr: - *Location:* already a winner—right at the alley entrance everyone passes on the way home from work.

segments.src: - *Komunikasi*: satu grup WhatsApp warga RT untuk menerima pesanan dan mengumumkan stok gas datang. Biayanya nol rupiah.
segments.tr: - *Communication:* one neighborhood WhatsApp group to take orders and announce when gas arrives. Cost: zero.

segments.src: - *Layanan*: gratis antar untuk belanja di atas Rp25.000, buka sampai pukul 23.00 — jam yang tidak dilayani dengan cara yang sama oleh pesaing besar.
segments.tr: - *Service:* free delivery for purchases over Rp25,000, open until 11 p.m.—hours not served the same way by larger competitors.

segments.src: Apa yang ia korbankan?
segments.tr: What does she sacrifice?

segments.src: Kelengkapan barang dan gengsi "toko besar".
segments.tr: Product completeness and the prestige of being a "big store."

segments.src: Apa yang ia dapat?
segments.tr: What does she gain?

segments.src: Sebuah alasan spesifik bagi 200-an keluarga terdekat untuk tetap membelinya.
segments.tr: A specific reason for about 200 nearby families to keep buying from her.

segments.src: Ilustrasi ini disederhanakan, tentu saja — angkanya perlu diuji di lapangan.
segments.tr: This illustration is simplified, of course—the numbers need to be tested in the field.

segments.src: Tapi logikanya berlaku untuk toko kelontong, kedai kopi di Bandung, maupun toko daring di marketplace: **pilih siapa, tentukan janji, lalu selaraskan semua elemen dengan janji itu.**
segments.tr: But the logic applies to grocery stores, coffee shops in Bandung, and online stores in marketplaces: **choose whom, make a promise, then align all elements with that promise.**

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Strategi ritel = pasar sasaran + bauran ritel + keunggulan bersaing yang sulit ditiru, dan ketiganya harus saling mendukung.
segments.tr: 1. Retail strategy = target market + retail mix + hard-to-copy competitive advantage, and all three must support each other.

segments.src: 2. Bauran ritel punya enam tuas — ragam barang, harga, lokasi/saluran, promosi, suasana toko, dan layanan — yang semuanya harus membuktikan satu janji yang sama.
segments.tr: 2. Retail mix has six levers—product assortment, price, location/channel, promotion, store atmosphere, and service—all of which must prove one same promise.

segments.src: 3. Positioning menuntut trade-off: memilih segmen berarti dengan sadar melepaskan segmen lain, karena toko yang mengincar semua orang tidak punya alasan khusus untuk dipilih siapa pun.
segments.tr: 3. Positioning requires trade-offs: choosing a segment means consciously abandoning others, because a store that chases everyone has no special reason to be chosen by anyone.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Check Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Manakah yang **BUKAN** termasuk elemen bauran ritel?
segments.tr: **1.** Which is **NOT** part of retail mix elements?

segments.src: a) Kebijakan harga
segments.tr: a) Price policy

segments.src: b) Tata letak dan suasana toko
segments.tr: b) Store layout and atmosphere

segments.src: c) Tingkat suku bunga acuan bank sentral
segments.tr: c) Central bank reference interest rate

segments.src: d) Ragam barang yang dijual
segments.tr: d) Product variety offered

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Keunggulan bersaing yang paling berkelanjutan bagi peritel kecil adalah menetapkan harga paling murah di kawasannya.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) The most sustainable competitive advantage for small retailers is setting the lowest prices in their area.

segments.src: **3.** Sebuah kedai kopi memposisikan diri sebagai "tempat kerja nyaman berjam-jam untuk mahasiswa".
segments.tr: **3.** A coffee shop positions itself as "a comfortable workspace for students to work for hours."

segments.src: Keputusan bauran ritel mana yang paling **tidak** konsisten dengan posisi tersebut?
segments.tr: Which retail mix decision is most **inconsistent** with this positioning?

segments.src: a) Menyediakan banyak stopkontak dan Wi-Fi cepat
segments.tr: a) Offering many outlets and fast Wi-Fi

segments.src: b) Membatasi waktu duduk maksimal 45 menit pada jam sibuk
segments.tr: b) Limiting seating time to a maximum of 45 minutes during peak hours

segments.src: c) Menyediakan menu kopi ukuran besar dengan harga bersahabat
segments.tr: c) Offering large coffee sizes at friendly prices

segments.src: d) Memilih kursi yang empuk dan meja yang cukup lebar
segments.tr: d) Choosing comfortable chairs and sufficiently wide tables

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terminology

segments.src: - **Strategi ritel** — pernyataan yang menetapkan pasar sasaran, bauran ritel yang dipakai, dan dasar keunggulan bersaing sebuah toko.
segments.tr: - **Retail strategy** — a statement that establishes a store's target market, the retail mix it uses, and the basis of its competitive advantage.

segments.src: - **Pasar sasaran (target market)** — kelompok pembeli spesifik yang secara sadar dipilih untuk dilayani, hasil dari proses segmentasi.
segments.tr: - **Target market** — a specific group of buyers consciously chosen to serve, the result of the segmentation process.

segments.src: - **Bauran ritel (retail mix)** — kombinasi ragam barang, harga, lokasi/saluran, promosi, suasana toko, dan layanan yang dipakai untuk memuaskan pasar sasaran.
segments.tr: - **Retail mix** — the combination of product assortment, price, location/channel, promotion, store atmosphere, and service used to satisfy the target market.

segments.src: - **Positioning** — posisi yang ingin ditempati di benak pelanggan dibandingkan pesaing, yang harus dibuktikan lewat seluruh elemen bauran ritel.
segments.tr: - **Positioning** — the position you want to occupy in customers' minds compared to competitors, which must be proven through all elements of the retail mix.

segments.src: - **Keunggulan bersaing berkelanjutan** — kelebihan yang bisa dipertahankan dalam jangka panjang karena sulit ditiru pesaing, misalnya lokasi unik, loyalitas pelanggan, atau sistem operasi yang efisien.
segments.tr: - **Sustainable competitive advantage** — an advantage that can be maintained long-term because it's hard for competitors to copy, such as unique location, customer loyalty, or efficient operations.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) c — suku bunga acuan adalah faktor lingkungan makro di luar kendali peritel, bukan tuas yang bisa diatur dalam bauran ritel.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) c — the reference interest rate is a macro environmental factor outside retailers' control, not a lever that can be adjusted in the retail mix.

segments.src: 2) X — harga termurah paling mudah ditiru dan biasanya dimenangkan pemain besar yang punya daya beli lebih kuat ke pemasok; keunggulan yang bertahan lama justru datang dari hal yang menumpuk pelan-pelan seperti lokasi, relasi pelanggan, dan efisiensi operasi.
segments.tr: 2) F — the lowest price is easiest to copy and usually won by large players with stronger buying power from suppliers; long-lasting advantage comes from things that accumulate slowly like location, customer relations, and operational efficiency.

segments.src: 3) b — membatasi waktu duduk secara langsung bertentangan dengan janji "tempat kerja nyaman berjam-jam"; pilihan a, c, dan d justru memperkuat janji itu.*
segments.tr: 3) b — limiting seating time directly contradicts the promise of "comfortable workspace for hours"; options a, c, and d actually reinforce that promise.*
